subject: Recap: Integration checklist & vector migration options for LumenRetail
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@lumenretail.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@procurement.lumenretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Integration checklist & vector migration options for LumenRetail

Hi Emma / Tom — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the technical POC. Marked items where we need confirmation from your infra team.

Key decisions discussed:
- SDK & auth: you’ll evaluate OIDC (preferred) vs API key for service-to-service calls. We recommended OIDC for longer-lived integrations + key rotation.
- Routing: traffic split plan — start hosted Redwood API for dev, route high-volume search traffic to Dedicated pool in us-west for lower latency.
- Embeddings: two candidate vector sizes discussed — 1536 (better off-the-shelf semantic fidelity) vs 1024 (lower storage/cost). We suggested preserving original semantics and testing both with your 50k sample set.
- Batching & normalization: target batch sizes of 64–128 tokens for throughput; we’ll provide normalization guidance (unit L2-normalize vectors post-generation) and a small script.
- Migration: current provider is Pinecone; discussed export format and ID remapping. We’ll provide a one‑week migration playbook.

Action items (owner / ETA):
1) Lumen: share a 10–50k sample of product descriptions + a short search QA set (Emma) — ETA Tues 10/26.
2) Redwood: send SDK init + OIDC flow example and a small normalizer script (Jonas) — ETA Fri 10/23.
3) Infra check: confirm firewall egress and CIDR allowlist for dedicated pool (Tom/infra) — ETA Mon 10/26.
4) Schedule technical POC run (1–2 days) after sample ingestion to compare 1024 vs 1536 vectors (Marissa) — propose week of 11/2.

Attachments: I’m attaching a short proposal with auth options and a CSV comparing estimated storage/cost for 1024 vs 1536 dims.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Emma Liu <emma@lumenretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@procurement.lumenretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Integration checklist & vector migration options for LumenRetail

Thanks Jonas — good summary. Quick answers:
- I’ll pull a 25k sample (mix of B2C product pages / long blurbs and short descriptions) and upload to the Drive link you shared. ETA Mon 10/26 morning.
- We prefer OIDC but need the sample flow so our security team can validate.
- For routing: we will start with hosted for dev/staging. For production we want dedicated (us-west) due to regional latency SLAs. Can you include expected latency numbers for both modes?

One ask from procurement: we need a short note about data retention, logs, and auditability for the POC (SOC2 scope). Tom — can you confirm any procurement constraints?

—Emma
Emma Liu
Sr. Product Manager, Search & Personalization
LumenRetail
emma@lumenretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@lumenretail.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@procurement.lumenretail.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Integration checklist & vector migration options for LumenRetail

Emma — adding a few technical clarifications per our infra/ML notes:
- Latency: hosted endpoints typical p50 token latency ~15–30ms (depending on model) for generation; for embeddings p50 is ~8–20ms per request when using single-item calls. Dedicated (pinned GPU pool) tends to be ~20–60% lower tail latency at scale; I’ll attach a short chart. We’ll provide concrete numbers from a small benchmark run as part of the POC.
- Embedding dims: practical advice — start with 1536 for semantic search quality; if cost or index size is a blocker, use 1024 and factor in a lightweight reranker (we can run a neural reranker on top of top-K).
- Batching: we recommend dynamic batching in the SDK side with a max batch of 128 vectors for ingestion. For online search (low latency) keep single calls and use prefix caching + small memcache for hot keys.

I attached the SDK init & OIDC example and the small normalizer script (normalize_l2.py). Jonas — ping me if you want me on the POC call week of 11/2 to own the benchmark.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: lumen-sdk-auth-proposal.pdf, normalize_l2.py

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@procurement.lumenretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma@lumenretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Integration checklist & vector migration options for LumenRetail

Folks — procurement constraints: we need to confirm that PII is not stored in embeddings and that logs for the POC are retained for 90 days. Also need a short statement on data exportability and key rotation for OIDC. Can Redwood provide a one-page SOC2 note for the trial? If yes, please send to procurement@lumenretail.com.

Tom Reynolds
Head of Procurement — LumenRetail
procurement@lumenretail.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@procurement.lumenretail.com>, Emma Liu <emma@lumenretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Integration checklist & vector migration options for LumenRetail

Tom / Emma — understood. Short answers and next steps: 
- PII & embeddings: Redwood does not recommend storing raw PII in embeddings. For the POC we’ll run a scrub step (we can supply a lightweight PII filter) before ingestion. Confirm if you have additional redaction rules.
- Logs & retention: we can enable 90-day retention for POC logs in the hosted trial; for Dedicated we can mirror logs to your SIEM via S3/KMS.
- OIDC key rotation & exportability: we’ll provide the OIDC flow doc and a one-page SOC2 scope note for procurement. Attaching the SOC2 summary and the embedding-dim-comparison.csv for your finance modeling.
- Migration playbook: we’ll produce a step-by-step Pinecone -> Redwood export/import with ID mapping and verification checks (hash matching). Target draft by Fri 10/30.

Next meeting: propose a 30-min technical kickoff with infra + search engineers on Tue 11/2 at 10am PT. Marissa / Karthik will demo ingestion + small benchmark.

If that works, I’ll send calendar invites and a short agenda.

Best —
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-summary-onepager.pdf, embedding-dim-comparison.csv
